visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character wearing a grey hoodie and a dark baseball cap walks into a hotel room. She carries a small black shoulder bag. The room features beige walls, a white bed on the left, and a large window at the back with a view of urban skyscrapers. (2) The camera moves closer to the window, revealing a panoramic view of Victoria Harbour with ships and coastal infrastructure under an overcast sky. The character is briefly seen reflected in the glass or sitting on a turquoise armchair by the window. (3) The scene cuts to the bedroom showing two twin beds with crisp white linens and warm bedside lighting. It then transitions to the bathroom, which has a beige marble countertop, a large mirror, a traditional bathtub with a handheld showerhead, and a glass-enclosed shower stall. (4) The footage moves to the hotel lobby, showcasing a grand interior with high-gloss floors, metallic pillars, long escalators, and a curved wooden staircase. Large windows look out onto lush green trees and more high-rise buildings. (5) The final sequence shows an outdoor pool area with turquoise water, surrounded by white umbrellas and purple flower bushes. Several people are visible in the background lounging or walking. The area is completely enclosed by massive glass-clad skyscrapers and mist-covered hills in the distance.

It aims to showcase the property's prime location in Central, its impressive harbour views, and its amenities (lobby, pool, bar) through a fast-paced visual montage coupled with descriptive subtitles to influence travel and accommodation decisions.
